_comment: Cards that exist only for the become_copy test (tests/unit/test_become_copy.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_mime` is Gogo's shape -- become a copy of another creature you control until end of turn, except the name. `t_token_mime` is the near miss the DSL could already write, using copy_permanent, which leaves the original untouched and adds a permanent the card never creates.

cards.name: Test Mime
cards.oracle_text: When this creature enters, you may have it become a copy of another target creature you control until end of turn, except its name is Test Mime.
